question:
A 29-year-old man is brought to the emergency department by his sister after she prevented him from
attempting to jump off the balcony of his high-rise apartment. The patient states, “I had to listen to the
voices. They finally told me to fly away.” Over the past 5 months, he has experienced a 10-kg (22-lb)
weight loss due to decreased appetite and lack of energy. Two months ago, he lost his job after
repeated absences and has since spent most of his time sleeping in his apartment. He expresses
indifference about losing his job, stating that he felt “inadequate and stupid” anyway. Once an avid
chess player, he stopped playing because he could no longer concentrate. He reports hearing voices
for the past 7 months, which began giving him instructions 3 weeks ago. On examination, he appears
thin and unkempt, with a depressed mood and flat affect. Physical examination reveals no
abnormalities, and urine toxicology screening is negative. Which of the following is the most likely
diagnosis? Answer Choices: (A) Delusional disorder with depressive features (B) Schizophrenia (C)
Brief psychotic disorder (D) Substance-induced psychotic disorder (E) Schizophreniform disorder (F)
Schizoaffective disorder (G) Bipolar I disorder with psychotic features (H) Major depressive disorder
with catatonic features (I) Mood disorder with psychotic features (J) Psychotic disorder due to another
medical condition
 A. Schizophrenia
B. Mood disorder with psychotic features
C. Substance-induced psychotic disorder
D. Schizophreniform disorder
E. Bipolar I disorder with psychotic features
F. Psychotic disorder due to another medical condition
G. Brief psychotic disorder
H. Delusional disorder with depressive features
I. Major depressive disorder with catatonic features
J. Schizoaffective disorder
